description: Follow-up to .14.2.1 discovered during adapter review: Jido.Chat.ChannelMeta defaults is_dm=false without proving a room; shared-history stamping therefore remains nil for typed metadata without explicit room type. Audit supported Mattermost/Slack/Teams/Discord/Telegram adapter event facts at the verified event origin, normalize explicit channel/group type or adapter-confirmed DM before bridge routing, and keep missing/unknown kinds fail-closed. Do not use untrusted webhook is_dm/metadata, fallback false or a first connector guess. Tests FIRST with real provider event fixtures and cross-provider/config mismatch, including nonmention passive capture readiness; keep channel-specific code in Channels. No new Action/tool or E2E authoring; consult Channels guide and Action reuse.
title: [zaq-emb.14.2.3] Verify platform room-type evidence
